svg.title: Emirhan Ünal · game developer
svg.desc: ASCII art profile card. A glowing neon sign reads EMİRHAN ÜNAL. Below, a blond, broad-shouldered developer sits at two monitors at night with a white cat on his lap and cherry blossoms outside the window. Then three animated panels: multiplayer netcode, mobile games, and the Rust game engine he is building, plus cards for TaterUp on Steam, VR at TÜSEB, a 200+ member game dev club and teaching 100+ students.
